q: When did the president of the Confederate States of America end his fight in the Mexican-American war?

traj.txt:
The President of the Confederate States of America was **Jefferson Davis**. He served as a colonel in the United States Army during the Mexican-American War, commanding the 1st Mississippi Rifles.

The Mexican-American War officially ended with the signing of the **Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo** on **February 2, 1848**. While the war effectively concluded with the capture of Mexico City in September 1847, the formal end date is recognized as the ratification of the treaty. Jefferson Davis was mustered out of the volunteer service in **July 1847**, shortly after the war's major combat operations had ceased, but the conflict itself officially ended in early 1848.

Exact Answer: February 2, 1848
